description: This file defines the AuthState class, a state management class for authentication in a Flutter application. It handles authentication operations such as initialize, signIn, signUp, and signOut, managing session tokens, user data, and notifying listeners about state changes.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing authentication state, including login, logout, session persistence, and user session management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the authentication state by reading stored tokens and user data from session storage and updating the client with the access token.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Performs user sign-in, updates the token and user info, handles errors, and manages loading state.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Handles user registration and updates session data similarly to signIn.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Clears session data and resets authentication state.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Private method to update the loading state and notify listeners.
